name: Brook Links
description: A quiet garden of paired stones. Draw a stream between each matching pair without crossing. A garden each day that remembers your best, or a new one whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A garden of 5 by 5 up to 7 by 7 with pairs of matching stones. Draw a stream between each pair; streams never cross or branch.
help.goal: Link every pair of stones. Covering every cell with a stream is optional and earns a full garden bonus. There is no timer, and fewer moves is only a bonus.
howToPlay: Find two stones with the same letter and colour. Each pair is one stream.
Start on a stone and draw toward its partner, one cell at a time. A stream cannot pass through another stream or another colour's stone.
Streams that run out of room can be pulled back and redrawn. Take your time: every garden has a way to link all pairs, and one that also fills every cell.

Today's garden is the same for everyone today and remembers your best. New garden deals a fresh one. Restart clears the streams, and Undo takes back your last stroke. Size cycles through 5 by 5, 6 by 6 and 7 by 7.

controls.action: Move between cells, or extend the stream you are drawing
On a stone, start its stream; on the stream's end, stop drawing
Retract the stream you are drawing by one cell
Reach Size, Undo, Restart and the garden buttons

tips: Start with stones in corners and along the edges: they have fewest ways out.
Press Enter on any cell of a stream to carry on drawing from there.
Hug the edges and walls of other streams so no empty pocket is left behind.
You can stop at any time. Your garden is saved and waits for you.
